A major [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] military '''installation''' was constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duroon]]<ref name="End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The installation was the only one on the planet with a full-dress [[Spaceport/Legends|port]]. By the time of his [[Mission to Duroon|mission]] delivering weapons to [[Duroon Rebels|rebels]] on Duroon, the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] knew about the installation.<ref name="End" />
